observations: Screens: web app 26 entries (17 user-facing app pages + 9 system/internal/component), 27 public-seo pages, Android 54 entries (52 app screens covering all 53 navigator routes — 5 tabs + 48 stack, Routes/Route merged — plus ErrorBoundary and the mobile/preview harness), 3 prototype/reference entries; 6 branches add 33 new/substantially changed UI screens/components (1 new web page sortie.html, 3 new Android routes RoutePlanner, Places, ShareStory).

Empty states: web uses .sig-empty/.asc-empty with a 24-grid line icon + text (≈18 instances); only Records shows a real illustration (assets/objects/relique-maitrise). Android EmptyState shows an icon badge (most) or the brand mark.png (brand, 5 uses: Progress, Journal, Records, Career, Goals). No empty state anywhere uses world/character art.
Error/offline: web network-error.html, 404.html and every .asc-empty error are text-only; Android ErrorState is a red alert icon badge; ErrorBoundary text-only; OfflineBanner 16px icon.

Only 4 world paintings, 4 guardians, 6 avatars, 7 rank badges and 3 objects exist as real art; they are reused across QG header, Aventure, Atelier trials, Défi/Cordée views and 17 public pages. assets/renaissance/valley-small.webp is the hero of 12 public pages.
TITAN LIVE (web seance-live and Android LiveSession) has no background painting; Camp de base has no image (DESIGN.md open item confirmed).
Chapter beacons are vector only (TitanCrest.beacon / BeaconEmblem); raster balise-chapitre-01..03 are proposed in design/titan-visual-library but not integrated.

Parity gaps: web Records/Atelier/Aventure use assets/objects (relic/chest/seal); mobile/assets has no objects folder. Web stats has no SVG charts (CSS bars only) while Android Progress has BarChart/LineChart. Android Welcome/Tour show hero + paintings while web login.html has no image. Android Cordée has no route painting (web does).
DESIGN.md §10 is outdated about crests: all 7 rank badges exist on web (assets/ranks) and Android (mobile/assets/rank).

Branches add mostly text/chip UI: RPG V1.5 (branches, guardian mechanics, clues notebook, chronicles) adds no new art beyond reusing guardian -s portraits; coaching V1.9 and clubs V1.8 are chip/text heavy; GPS V1.7.7 draws on canvas/SVG with a neutral grid unless tiles are configured; sharing adds a 9:16 canvas story card with 3 styles and a new mobile/assets/brand/relief.png.
New Android routes on branches (RoutePlanner, Places, ShareStory) are not added to ROUTE_SPACE in mobile/src/theme/space.tsx, so they would take the QG cyan instead of their space colour.

Legacy raster sets image/boss (66.6 MB), image/avatar (44.4 MB), image/mob (23.4 MB) ≈134 MB are not used by the current UI; their .webp copies still ship in dist (build skips only PNG/JPG with a webp sibling).
Naming overlaps between avatars, guardians and ranks (Sentinelle ×3, Gardien(ne) ×3, Artisan ×2) may confuse iconography.
Cosmetic frames (mobile/src/core/cosmetics.ts) use glow, which DESIGN.md's Don't list forbids for UI.
coaching.html and boutique.html use data-territory values 'coaching' and 'atelier', not among the six spaces in DESIGN.md (mapping unverified).
No 21-tier (paliers) system exists in code; only 7 ranks and 10 per-sport mastery paliers.
